summary: Server-owned NeoForge configuration exposes the active 1.12.2 base, turret, expander and addon tuning values without changing registry identity or defaults.

authoritative_state: NeoForge SERVER config owns gameplay tuning values and the logical server reads them at use time.
All blocks, items, entities, menus and data components remain registered independently of configuration.
Default values reproduce the OpenModularTurrets 1.12.2 defaults used by the current port.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: All tuning and validation remain functional without loading client classes.

generated: No generated game assets are changed by runtime configuration.

budgets.scope: One turret tick or resource formula evaluation
budgets.measurement: Count bounded scalar SERVER config lookups during one turret decision cycle.

hot_paths: Base energy receive and capacity queries
performance.measurement_environment: Java 21 and NeoForge 21.1.234 dedicated GameTest server.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

covers: Five base tiers, five power expanders, addon generators and all eleven turret definitions expose the declared 1.12.2 defaults.
Accuracy, efficiency and recycler tuning remain independently configurable for all eleven turret definitions with legacy defaults 0.2, 0.08 and 0.10.
tests.expected: All defaults and representative formula consumers match the legacy values exactly.

Enabled rocket and grenade terrain explosions use strengths 2.3 and 1.4.

covers: SERVER config registration and common gameplay access load without client classes.
tests.expected: Dedicated server reaches Done and creates the server configuration without registry errors.

covers: Configuration does not alter generated registry resources or introduce asset drift.
tests.expected: DataGen, static analysis and asset reconciliation pass without differences or warnings.

steps: Create a world and inspect openmodularturrets-server.toml.
Stop the server, change one base capacity and one turret range value, then restart.
Inspect existing bases and turrets without replacing them.
manual_checks.expected: Existing machines use the new server-owned values after restart while every registry id remains stable.

non_goals: Conditional registration or removal of blocks, items, entities, recipes or data components.
Third-party Ender IO, Mekanism, IC2, ComputerCraft or OpenComputers recipe and integration switches.
Editable per-base target priority state, which is covered by a separate migration phase.
Rendering, model, texture and current GUI interaction defect repair.
Direct loading or conversion of Minecraft 1.12.2 world saves.
